name: How do I know if my roof has wind damage?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my roof has wind damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for visible signs like missing, curled, cracked, or loose shingles, especially after a storm. Also, check for debris on your lawn, such as shingle granules or pieces of roofing material. Sometimes, internal signs like water stains on your ceiling can indicate wind-related damage allowing water penetration. During our inspection, we can help identify subtle wind uplift damage that isn't always obvious from the ground, ensuring all affected areas are noted.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing, curled, or cracked shingles and roof debris after a storm. Water stains inside your home can also signal wind damage.
